data.name: Rizala
data.gender_notes: Rizala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rizala is a unisex Islamic name derived from the Arabic word 'rizalah', which means 'secret' or 'mystery'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to signify the secret or mystery of Allah, emphasizing the divine and spiritual aspects of the name. The name Rizala carries the meaning “Secret of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rizala usually hope their child will grow to embody secret of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A bearer of this name is considered to be divinely inspired and spiritually aware, with a deep understanding of the mysteries and secrets of the universe.
data.etymology: Rizala belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Secret of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rizala total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizala holds a unique cultural significance within the Islamic world. While it is a unisex name, it is most commonly used for girls as a reminder of the deep, hidden closeness and connection that exists between the Creator and His creations. It implies a sense of secrecy and protection, emphasizing the idea that the wonders and depths of Allah's creation are vast and unfathomable.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rizala highlights the idea of the divine mystery and its presence in all aspects of life. It insinuates that the true essence and meaning of existence lie in the relationship between the believer and Allah. By evoking a sense of wonder and curiosity, the name encourages exploration of the spiritual dimensions of existence and serves as a reminder of the profound, unending mystery of Allah. Ultimately, the name Rizala offers a profound way to connect with the divine, inspiring awe, reverence, and spiritual growth within those who bear this name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rizala: The Protected One. In Islamic tradition, the name Rizala symbolizes one who is shielded and safeguarded by Allah, providing them strength and security in times of hardship. This name also signifies trust and reliance on Allah, as He is the ultimate protector and provider.
